title: Chapter 40 Repairing The Camp
content:
Chapter 40 Repairing The Camp

A narrow figure eight canyon, with a collapsed city wall in front.

Inside the city wall, most of the houses have been razed to the ground, and only a few houses still have a few walls standing.

The overall area is not small, and can accommodate hundreds of people.

Wang Shuo stepped into the camp, and the system prompt sounded:

[Found a ruined camp, repair the base camp, and activate the camp NPC. ]

Wang Shuo patrolled around and found a "base camp".

It turned out to be similar to his "shelter core".

The system prompts that energy crystals can be put in for repair.

Wang Shuo killed a lot of skeleton soldiers along the way and collected a lot of energy crystals. He originally had a lot of them, so he directly put in 100 energy crystals.

[The camp "base camp" is being repaired, 1%...]

Soon, the base camp was repaired, and a tent appeared in front of him.

Wang Shuo walked into the base camp and was immediately caught in a scene animation.

Countless players are active in this camp. They form teams here to go to the Gobi Desert, kill skeleton soldiers and skeleton knights, obtain resources, return to the camp to rest, exchange items with the NPCs in the camp, build equipment, and enhance their strength.

But not long after, the overwhelming skeleton soldiers, skeleton knights, wronged souls, and some other undead creatures began to attack the camp. Although many players fought desperately, there were too many undead creatures, and the camp was eventually razed to the ground.

After the scene animation ended, the "core" of the base camp sank into the sand table in the tent, and an uncle with a headscarf on his head appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

At first, the uncle's expression was dull, his eyes were dull, and his face was expressionless.

After a while, his expression became natural, as if he was reborn.

"Hello!" Wang Shuo greeted tentatively.

"Did you trigger the mission? Thank you, brave adventurer!"

"I am Zhao Bangde, the quartermaster of this camp. I am responsible for issuing missions to you. At the same time, you can exchange the items you need from me!"

Wang Shuo looked at the quartermaster named Zhao Bangde in front of him, and for a moment he was a little confused whether he was a player.

After all, he looked too much like a player, but the tone of his voice was a little stiff, as if he deliberately made such a tone.

He threw a "Breaking Eye" skill.

[ID:JHK3647 Zhao Bangde]

[Level:? ? Level]

[Identity: Quartermaster of Huangfeng Valley Camp, responsible for issuing tasks and exchanging items for players. ]

"Captain Zhao, what can you exchange?"

"Young man, I can exchange things here, only you can't think of them, but you can't exchange them. After all, I am now working for Lord Zach!"

Wang Shuo was shocked. This time he spoke much faster and more fluently.

What shocked Wang Shuo even more was that this NPC Zhao Bangde actually knew Lord Zak, which completely overturned Wang Shuo's understanding of NPCs.

General system NPCs can only communicate in simple and mechanical ways. What is the situation of Zhao Bangde?

"How do you know Lord Zak?"

Zhao Bangde looked at Wang Shuo as if he was looking at an idiot. He looked at Wang Shuo for a while before answering indifferently: "I am my own boss, how could I not know?"

Then, he pondered for a while, as if digesting some information.

"Uh, so that's it. You kid, are you still in the novice trial?" He looked as if he had suddenly realized something.

"Naturally, I also received a mission and came here to be a quartermaster. As for what I did before, I can't say."

"Are you a system NPC or a player?"

"I have no answer for this question."

Wang Shuo fell into deeper doubts. Since Zhao Bangde refused or could not answer.

Wang Shuo turned to ask Chang Gui.

Chang Gui explained: "This Zhao Bangde should be a tool man whose soul was sealed by Lord Zak, and was chosen by Lord Zak to be an NPC. By completing Lord Zak's tasks many times, he has the opportunity to awaken all his consciousness and become a player again."

"In this case, he should have awakened part of his consciousness. You can regard him as an advanced AI. This is also what I said before. Being a tool man, there is still a chance to awaken consciousness."

"So that's it." Wang Shuo said to Zhao Bangde, "Do you have any tasks I can accept?"

"Of course."

[System prompt: Quartermaster Zhao Bangde has issued a task to you. Do you accept it? ]

[Task 1: Repair the camp (build at least 2 houses and repair the city wall), task reward: horse brand × 1, riding skill book × 1, military merit points: 50 points. ]

[Task 2: Kill 100 skeleton soldiers to prove your strength. Reward: a void positioning stone, military merit points: 200 points. 】

"Accept."

Repairing the camp can not only enhance one's own safety, but also obtain rich rewards, so Wang Shuo is naturally very happy.

The Void Positioning Stone should be bound to the Void Portal in one's territory, and then one will not be teleported immediately when entering the Void Battlefield. This thing must be obtained.

Wang Shuo stopped talking nonsense and searched around.

Found a dry well buried by wind and sand, it seems that there should be a water source here.

Wang Shuo immediately built a well on the original site.

After having water, mud pits and clay can be made in large quantities, and then kilns can be used to make bricks, build houses and repair city walls.

Everything went smoothly. By noon, Wang Shuo had successfully obtained 10,000 pieces of clay and started to make brick kilns. Fortunately, he had brought a lot of supplies before, otherwise there would be big problems.

Seeing Wang Shuo's busy figure, Zhao Bangde got a pot of tea from somewhere and sat leisurely on a recliner, which made Wang Shuo grit his teeth.

Soon, Wang Shuo built two houses.

Then he started to repair the city wall. The length of the city wall was about 50 meters. It seemed that it would take 1 day to complete the repair.

In the evening, Wang Shuo lit a bonfire and roasted meat.

Zhao Bangde, who smelled the fragrance, also came over.

"It smells so good! I haven't eaten barbecue for a long time!"

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes at him and roasted meat by himself.

Seeing that Wang Shuo ignored him, Zhao Bangde was a little angry. This young man was not smart!

Shouldn't this be the best time for him to curry favor with him?

Wang Shuo didn't want to bother with the old man at this moment. When he was working hard to repair the camp, he didn't even come to help. He even asked me to do something about the house he lived in!

"Boy, if you can serve me with good wine and good food, I will tell you some information about the Yellow Wind Valley camp, so that you can avoid taking detours!"

"Uh."

Wang Shuo was still alone, enjoying the barbecue.

Under the night sky, the cold wind was rustling. Zhao Bangde waited for a long time, but Wang Shuo didn't take any action, and finally got angry.

But as an NPC, he couldn't do anything before the player attacked him.

He could only sulk alone, and couldn't even snatch Wang Shuo's food. This was the limitation given to him by the system.

After thinking for a while, he thought of a good way.
